verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no self-serve audience export. Nothing shows an export of contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history or the suppression list in an open format such as CSV. A paginated subscriber search API and CLI search exist, but these are developer building blocks a user would have to script into an export, and the documented CSV handling is import-only, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can export my entire audience — contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, and suppression list — in an open format, self-serve

citations.quote: Search subscribers by page and filters.
Search subscribers, import from CSV, manage tags and fields
